title: POCScanner - seasonality + volume profile AI
author: Sad_Kitchen1567
selftext:
Hi everyone,

I’m testing a new workflow on pocscanner to cut down on chart fatigue during my daily prep.

Instead of analyzing individual stocks one by one from scratch, I’ve set up a 3-step routine:



1. Seasonality & Sentiment: I first check historical monthly win rates/returns and the Smart Money index to avoid taking swings against the broader historical trend.

2. POC Screener: I run their scanner across the S&P 500 / Tech presets to filter strictly for stocks compressing at the Point of Control or breaking out of the Value Area (VAH/VAL).

3. Single-Stock Deep Dive: For the few setups that pass, I open the ticker chart for Anchored VWAP levels and run the built-in AI copilot to quickly map out risk/reward and invalidation points.



It’s completely free and saves me from clicking through dozens of random Finviz charts every morning.

What do you think of this approach? Do you use seasonality as an initial filter, or only as secondary confirmation?
